title: beta=0.5 DAgger data and 20k student: idle / action-distribution diagnosis
one_line: The 20,000-step student's dev idle share (60.87 %) matches its training-label prior (61.72 %) to 0.85 pp, and 66.16 % of those labels are idle because the teacher's 18-way geometry score is an exact tie in 44.58 % of decisions and the first-maximum rule then picks candidate 0 (idle); under a uniform random tie-break the same score vectors would yield 4.67 % idle. Idle is never the unique best action in 52,500 decisions.

inputs: touhou_rl/v410/teacher_audit.py + student/diagnostics.py (quote of the documented post-discount score convention, read-only)

action_space.encoder: cand = focus * 9 + move, shooting always on, bombing off (touhou_rl/v400/gym/actions.py)
action_space.idle_definition: cand == 0 (no direction held). cand 9 is focus-idle and is reported separately, never merged into idle.

label_semantics.chosen: chosen_plan.first_action == teacher_cand on 52,500/52,500 rows, so the BC target is always the teacher action; beta only decides what was executed, never what was labelled
label_semantics.executed: teacher_cand when injected (26,295 rows), student_cand otherwise (26,205 rows)
label_semantics.raw_geo_score: stored post-discount: unverified_discount = 5.0 is already subtracted from the 17 unverified candidates, so true[i] = raw[i] + 5.0 * (i != chosen). Documented in teacher_audit.py:1840-1867 and student/diagnostics.py:1048.
label_semantics.collector: the 15 shards were rolled out by one checkpoint, b0_s0_dagger_step1000.pt (sha256 6ebe4ea9..., shard.json), so 'student' below is the D1 collection student, not the 20k student

action_histogram_18.note: counts over all 52,500 DAgger decisions; teacher == label target

idle_confusion.note: rows x teacher/move, student idle vs move; idle means cand 0

label_prior_vs_dev.note: dagger_share = teacher labels on DAgger states; s1_share = teacher labels on the D410-S1 preference states; mix = 0.8 * dagger + 0.2 * s1 (the WP05.9 training mix); dev_share = the 20k student's 20 dev episodes (17,151 decisions)

teacher_tie_structure.note: true[i] = raw_geo_score[i] + 5.0*(i != chosen); the stored array is post-discount, so these are the teacher's real geometric gaps
teacher_tie_structure.counterfactual_note: recomputed offline on the stored scores; no engine, no new data, no training. 'random' is uniform over the exact maximiser set, 'move_first' takes the lowest-index non-idle maximiser, 'no_idle' removes candidate 0 from the action space.

position.note: chosen_plan.end_xy of every decision, i.e. the position after the 2-frame committed slot; playfield proxy, rollout model error <= 4 px

sequences.note: closed-loop sequences of the collection student (D1, b0_s0_dagger_step1000.pt) and of the executed action, 3,500 decisions per shard, 52,500 per arm

long_run_actions.note: decisions inside a student run of length >= 32, by action

cycles.note: exact period-p blocks (p = 2..6) with >= 2 distinct actions inside one period, block length >= max(8, 2p); constant runs excluded

horizontal_sliding.note: decisions inside a maximal run of one fixed horizontal action (E or W) of length >= 8

q1_teacher_idle_or_student_learned_idle.answer: both, with very different weights: the teacher's own label distribution is already 66.16 % idle, and the collection student adds +7.53 pp of its own (73.69 %). 87 % of the student's idle mass is teacher-endorsed; 13 % (5,006 rows, 9.53 % of all rows) is idle invented on rows where the teacher asked for a move.
q1_teacher_idle_or_student_learned_idle.why_teacher_idle_is_high: 44.58 % of the decisions have an exactly flat 18-way score; idle wins those by being candidate 0. 67.39 % of the teacher's idle labels come from those flat rows, and idle is never the unique best action in the whole corpus.

q2_direction_classes_with_near_zero_reca.answer: no direction class has exactly zero recall in the 20k dev histogram except class 9 (focus-idle), which has zero teacher rows and therefore zero training labels -- it is absent by construction, not learned away. Every other class is emitted at dev, but the vertically oriented ones collapse to 0.19-0.50x of their label prior while E/W grow to 1.33-1.44x.

q3_edge_or_fixed_direction_loops.answer: there is a pinning loop, but it is an idle-freeze, not a left/right slide loop: 31.9 % of all decisions sit inside a constant-action run of >= 512 decisions, 97.1 % of the decisions inside runs >= 32 are idle, 67.1 % of decision steps produce no position change at all, and only 0.28 % of decisions sit in a horizontal E/W run of >= 32. Exact two-action cycles (ABAB...) cover 0.09 %-0.92 % of decisions, so there is no short oscillation either.
q3_edge_or_fixed_direction_loops.caveat: positions come from chosen_plan.end_xy of the collection rollout (rollout model error <= 4 px); the dev episodes persist action histograms only, so the 20k student's own position band is not measured here

hypotheses.name: dev 的 idle 占比就是标签先验，不是策略漂移
hypotheses.statement: 20k 学生在 80/20 混合下把训练标签的 idle 先验（61.72 %）复现到 1 pp 以内；加步数只会让 dev idle 更靠近这个先验（1k 71.07 % → 5k 62.84 % → 20k 60.87 %），而不是离开它

evidence.source_1k_5k: EVAL_BETA05_20K.md section 6.2 (same 15 shards, same labels, same seed, only --steps changed)

hypotheses.falsifier: 如果换过权重的先验之后 dev idle 不跟着走（例如新先验 45 % 而 dev idle 仍在 58 % 以上），这条就被推翻
hypotheses.test_without_new_data: 把 dev 的逐类占比和 mix 先验对比（本文件 §4 已做）：残差 -0.84 pp
hypotheses.test_with_one_run: 同一批行、同一个 seed，把 idle 样本权重降到 0.5 重跑 20k，看 dev idle 是否落到新先验附近（~52 %）

hypotheses.name: 66 % 的 idle 标签是「取第一个最大值」tie-break 的工件
hypotheses.statement: 教师的 18 路分数在大多数决策上没有分辨力（44.58 % 完全打平、78.50 % 与次优完全打平），idle 从来不是唯一最大值，标签分布由「第一个最大值胜出」这条规则决定，而它总是先遇到候选 0
hypotheses.falsifier: 如果在打平行里分层抽样、用引擎分别验证 idle 与被并列的方向，发现 idle 确实系统性地更安全，那这个打平就是真实偏好而不是工件
hypotheses.test_without_new_data: §7 的反事实表（已完成）：同一批分数，随机 tie-break → 4.67 % idle
hypotheses.test_with_one_run: 用去平局后的分数（move-first 或带种子的随机）重新标一遍再训练：先验先动，dev idle 应该跟着动

hypotheses.name: 采集学生自己「卡住」的状态在供应 idle 标签
hypotheses.statement: idle 标签占比是「采集学生卡了多久」的单调函数：run 长度 = 1 时教师只标 20.39 % idle，run 4-7 时 12.74 %，run 32-127 时 76.48 %，run ≥ 512 时 98.41 %
hypotheses.falsifier: 如果第二轮采集以全新状态（run == 1）为主、idle 标签占比却仍是 ~66 %，这条就被推翻
hypotheses.test_without_new_data: §5 的 run 分桶表（已完成）
hypotheses.test_with_one_collection: 反卡死采集器（连续 K 次同一动作后强制换向）采一轮，idle 标签占比应降到 45 % 以下

hypotheses.name: 竖直/斜向动作被饿死，学生能做的事被先验封顶
hypotheses.statement: 教师的非 idle 质量 61 % 是水平向（E/W 20.69 % vs N+S 1.68 %、斜向 8.00 %），于是学生把质量从竖直搬到水平：dev 有 89.52 % 的决策是 idle 或纯水平，竖直/斜向 12 类里有 7 类在 dev 只剩先验的 0.14×–0.39×（NE 0.74×、SW 0.81× 是例外）
hypotheses.falsifier: 如果只写「只会 E/W/idle」的脚本策略在同样 20 个 dev 种子上活到和 20k 学生一样长（~1,715 帧），就说明缺竖直动作足以解释存活，而不只是相关
hypotheses.test_without_new_data: 把 dev 直方图和先验对比（已完成）：89.52 % 的 dev 决策是零位移或纯水平位移
hypotheses.test_with_one_eval: 用同一个 20 dev 种子评测一个脚本化的「只 E/W/idle」控制器（一次 eval，不训练）

recommendations.action: 先在源头修标签分布，再花任何算力：给几何分去平局，或者有意识地选择 tie-break 规则（move-first、带种子随机、或 idle 最后才选），然后离线重算这 52,500 条标签。§7 的反事实表明同一批分数在三行不同规则下给出 66.16 % / 4.67 % / 0.00 % 三种 idle。
recommendations.why: 现在 66.16 % 的 idle 不是教师偏好，而是候选 0 赢下了每一次并列
recommendations.cost: 只做离线重算，不需要引擎

recommendations.action: 重新平衡训练目标：把 idle 降到 D410-S1 的水平（43.96 %）或更低，并抬高只有 1.68 % / 8.00 % 的竖直、斜向和 focus 类。之后用新的先验衡量 dev idle，而不是对着 60.87 % 看。
recommendations.why: H1 预测 dev idle 跟随先验；dev 的逐类比值（竖直/斜向 12 类里 7 类跌到 0.14×–0.39×）说明先验已经是约束瓶颈
recommendations.cost: 一次 20k 训练，带样本权重，不需要新数据

recommendations.action: 第二轮 DAgger 要让采集器「反卡死」：连续 K 次（K ≈ 16–32）执行同一动作后强制换向，并在卡死期间以 β=1.0 注入教师；同时记录 run 长度，好让新数据能对照 H3 检查。
recommendations.why: 31.9 % 的决策落在 ≥ 512 的 run 里，这些行 98.41 % 被标成 idle；用同一个采集器再采一轮只会复现同一个状态分布
recommendations.cost: 一轮采集（本轮不做，留给 WP05.12）

recommendations.action: 不要在现有语料上加步数：5k → 20k 用 4 倍预算只换来 -1.97 pp 的 dev idle 和 +25.55 帧，而且 dev idle 已经收敛到标签先验上。
recommendations.why: 先验不变，再大的优化压力也不可能把 idle 压到先验以下

recommendations.action: 让「贴边 idle」在评测时可测：20 个 dev 局只持久化动作直方图，所以 20k 学生的位置带（y ≥ 380、x ≤ 48）根本无法核对。给 eval summary 加上逐局 x/y 分带占比和 idle run 长度分布。
recommendations.why: 贴边/卡死的证据现在只来自采集 rollout，不来自被测学生
recommendations.cost: eval summary 里加一行，不需要改引擎

not_claimed: NOT G410-2: no confirm seed was run, no gate is evaluated, no pass rate or development score is defined or implied
no training, no data collection, no new DAgger round, no shard regenerated, no engine run of any kind
this is not a claim that the teacher's idle labels are unsafe: only that they are tie-determined, and that the label distribution is what the student reproduces
this is not a claim that the 20k student hugs an edge at dev: its position band is not logged (R5); the position numbers come from the collection rollout only
'random tie-break -> 4.67 % idle' is a counterfactual on the stored scores, not a proposed policy and not a claim that 4.67 % idle would survive better
single training seed (0), single checkpoint, single collector checkpoint (b0_s0_dagger_step1000); no variance estimate
the 18-way recomputation depends on the documented conventions unverified_discount = 5.0 and verify_k = 1; if either changes the decomposition changes with it
D410-S1 numbers are the teacher target_counts recorded in train_beta05_20k.json; the S1 rows were not re-read here
limits: 五个 β=0.5 臂共用同一个采集 checkpoint，所以 shard 统计里的 student 是采集学生 D1，永远不会是 20k 臂
labels.jsonl 只对 chosen 一个候选做了验证，所以「被并列的那个方向同样安全」无法用这份数据核对
位置通道是几何 rollout 的 end_xy（模型误差 ≤ 4 px，抽样行 trajectory_matches = false），不是引擎里的玩家坐标
run/循环分析用的是 15 个 shard 的序列（52,500 决策）；dev 局只存直方图
DAgger 状态先验（66.16 %）和 S1 状态先验（43.96 %）的对比把「状态分布」和「产生它的 rollout 策略」混在一起——这是描述性的，不是受控 A/B

checks.check: per-episode histograms sum to the pooled one
mix prior reproduces the published majority baseline
every flat row is labelled idle
idle labels == flat rows + idle-as-maximiser rows
focus share consistent with the class table
